Application Description

当班主任之后才发现：真正耗人的不是上课，是记事。 谁请假、谁迟到、谁缺勤、谁没交作业、这场考试均分多少、分数段怎么分布、座位要不要再调、期末评语从哪写起、值日谁扫地谁当组长、调课通知怎么发给家长——Excel 表格开了又开，微信聊天翻了又翻，备忘录、班级群、纸质点名册来回切换。 「我不想当班主任」是专为班主任、副班主任、年级组长、任课老师设计的本地班级管理工具 / 班务助手 / 班级事务管理 App。不用注册、不用登录、不建账号；学生档案、考勤记录、作业反馈、成绩管理、课程表、调课助手、座位表、在校表现、评语管理、错题本、待办提醒、倒数日、值日安排、工作留痕、班级建设、学生积分等，默认都只保存在你自己的手机或电脑里，隐私更安心。支持多班级切换，一个 App 管多个班。 班级管理、学生管理、班主任工具、班务工作台、智慧班级、电子点名、课堂考勤、请假登记、作业检查、未交作业名单、优秀作业、订正作业、成绩录入、学情分析、均分统计、分数段、班级排名、课程表、个人课表、班级课表、调课代课、座位编排、排座位、评语库、学生评语、错题本、错题拍照、待办事项、教师待办、倒数日、考试倒计时、值日生、值日表、家访记录、班会记录、班级文化、班训班规、学生积分、加减分、本地存储、无网络也可用、Excel 导入导出、数据备份换机。 —— 学生档案 / 学生花名册 —— • 姓名、学号、性别、民族、生日、电话、家庭住址、家庭情况、监护人信息按班级分开管理 • 监护人类型可自定义（父亲、母亲、祖父、祖母，也可自建类型） • 支持 Excel、CSV 批量导入导出，表头识别更宽松，适合从学校下发的花名册、学籍表整理 • 单个学生可导出 PDF、Word 或图片，方便家访、约谈、材料存档 • 住宿信息选填：就餐、晚托、上下学方式等，寄宿班、走读班都能用 • 学生名单、关联学生默认按学号大小排序，查找更快 —— 考勤管理 / 电子点名 —— • 迟到、请假、缺勤、早退等异常当场记录 • 可切换「座位图点名」或「列表点名」，贴近真实教室 • 考勤类型可在设置里增删配置，适配各校习惯 • 考勤数据可进入学情、评语、表现等后续参考 —— 作业反馈 / 收作业 —— • 布置作业后快速点未交、已交、迟交、订正、优秀 • 支持导出「未交名单」「优秀名单」「订正名单」 • 名单可复制文字发班级群 / 家长群，也可生成图片分享 • 支持扫码登记：已交、订正、优秀，课堂收本更高效 —— 成绩管理 / 学情分析 —— • 录入各科考试成绩，查看均分、走势、分数段、需关注学生 • 支持科目筛选、班级排名相关查看 • Excel 导入导出，对接学校常用成绩表 • 自定义科目名称更稳，减少「科目对不上」的麻烦 —— 课程表 / 调课助手 —— • 支持多套课表：班级课表、个人课表、自定义课表 • 可新建、重命名、删除、一键切换课表 • 节次时间可改，节次与课程格子支持自定义颜色，一眼区分语数外、早晚自习 • 同一节可排单周 / 双周；设置开学日与大小周 • 右上角表格支持课表 Excel 导入导出 • 调课助手：对调、代课、挪课、停课，一键生成发给家长的调课通知文案 —— 座位表 / 智能排座 —— • 按学号、男女间隔、成绩等规则一键排座 • 可设置避开相邻（前后左右尽量不挨着） • 支持整体平移：整列左移右移、整排前移后移，调座位不用一个个拖 • 教师视角 / 学生视角切换（学生视角更符合孩子看讲台的方向） • 座位方案可导出，方便打印张贴 —— 在校表现 / 评语 / 错题本 —— • 表扬、进步、纪律等表现记入档案，排座和写评语都能用到 • 评语管理：内置大量基础评语，可按成绩、考勤、表现组合；支持 Excel 维护评语库 • 错题本：拍照入库，本地识字整理题目；待订正 / 已掌握分开看；可按科目、按学生归档 —— 待办提醒 / 倒数日 —— • 批改、收作业、家访、开会设好时间，到点提醒；可写入系统日历 • 支持语音输入待办，口语说时间也能识别；没说截止时间时自动给默认时间 • 待办快捷按钮可配置，常用事项一键添加 • 倒数日：考试、开学、放假、节日倒计时，重要日子不再靠人肉记 —— 值日安排 / 工作留痕 / 班级建设 —— • 值日分组轮换；组内可指定岗位（如组长、扫地等），支持调整顺序与一键均分 • 今日值日一目了然，适合早读前、放学后快速核对 • 工作留痕：家访、班会、家长沟通随时记；可附照片、视频、语音，应对检查少翻聊天记录 • 班级建设：班训、班规、班委会、活动荣誉、板报照片入库，班级文化有处放 —— 学生积分（可选开启）—— • 点名加减分、规则可配 • 段位、宠物等激励方式，让日常管理更有参与感 • 适合平时表现量化、小组竞赛、课堂激励 —— 备份、导出与多端 —— • 「我的」整包备份导出压缩包，换手机、换电脑再导入 • 解压后可用表格软件查看，关键数据自己掌控 • 现已支持 Mac 桌面版：左侧功能栏 + 右侧工作区，宽屏办公更适合备课、改成绩、排座位、导出名单 • 与 iPhone 版能力对齐，备份可互通（按你实际导出导入使用） —— 特别说明 —— • 本 App 面向教师自用班务管理，不是教育局官方学籍系统，不能代替成绩证明、学籍证明 • 学生姓名、电话、身份证号、家庭信息等由你本地保管；备份文件请勿发到公开群或网盘公开链接 • 相机、相册、麦克风、通知、日历等权限仅在使用对应功能时申请，可随时在系统设置关闭 • 适合小学班主任、初中班主任、高中班主任、中职班主任，以及需要管班的任课教师、实习教师 一句话总结：把点名册、成绩表、座位表、作业名单、课表、评语、值日表、家访记录，从零散表格和微信里收进一个「班主任班级管理」工具里——本地、好用、能导出、能备份，手机和电脑都能干活。

entry.title: SessionBand Jazz Fusion
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：₺499,99 → ₺199,99 [₺129,99 ~ ₺499,99]）

All Price Information

Price：₺199,99

Application Description

SessionBand Jazz Fusion – Tom Cawley Special Synth & Vintage Keys Edition Create studio-quality Jazz Fusion tracks to your own chords in minutes with this special artist edition of the award-winning SessionBand app - the world’s only chord-based loop app. With over 20,000 precision-cut, chord-based loops across 15 diverse Jazz Fusion styles included, the app instantly converts the chords you select into great-sounding audio - wherever you are and whatever your ability. Perfect for songwriters and producers and the ultimate play-along for jazz rock and pop instrumentalists. Highly acclaimed, multi award-winning pianist Tom Cawley is one of the most sought-after keyboard players in the world both as a jazz pianist (Dave Weckl, Jack DeJohnette, Charlie Watts, Jamie Cullum, Guy Barker...), and as a leading pop/rock keyboardist, recording and performing around the world with U2, Peter Gabriel, Andrea Bocelli, Amy Winehouse and many others. For this special Jazz Fusion edition, Tom is joined by 2 of the world's top session musicians: Simon Lea – Drums (Rod Stewart, Dionne Warwick, James Blunt, James Morrison, Katie Melua...) and Geoff Gascoyne – Bass (Sting, Van Morrison, Georgie Fame...). Tom's passion for jazz and for modern and vintage keys is reflected in the diverse range of styles in this edition. And Tom has employed many of the best keyboards from his vast personal collection: from the Oberheim OB-6, Prophet 12 and Moog Model D (as well as a modular set-up), to his vintage Fender Rhodes, Wurlitzer and Hohner Pianet - they all feature in the content of this app. And to do full justice to this genre, we have increased the number of chord variations to 15 for every root note in all 15 styles! Alongside pro features like automated mixing, auto-transpose, one-touch live recording and a range of export functions, there are new tech features and upgrades like channel FX, instant PDF chord sheets and 'Track Builder' to make your track creation quicker and easier. Fights! Goblins! And a lot of PLING. ---- A NOTE FROM THE DEVELOPER After my last game SUMMERHOUSE, I wanted to make something radically different. Still small, but faster, with numbers, fights and goblins! The result is SLOTS & DAGGERS. To make this game I combined a lot of things I deeply love – weird fantasy worlds, crude drawings of strange little guys, old school crunchy hip hop drum machines and addictive arcade games that go "PLING PLING PLING" as they spit out little coins – with classic roguelike mechanics. As with SUMMERHOUSE, please keep in mind this game is a solo project – small, focused, and made with care. It's meant to be short and sweet and doesn't have the amount of content as games built by bigger teams over years, but I think it's a fair deal! I hope you have a good time with SLOTS & DAGGERS! Cheers, Friedemann

Locked in a rusty cell with a slot machine and an ATM, you must pay off your debt at the end of each round, or fall to ruin – literally! Manipulate the slot machine to earn extra coins. Turn the odds in your favor with various prizes and charms that trigger big big combos, snowballing into a dazzling lucky run. Bend the rules, break the game, and pay off your captor long enough to earn a shot at freedom. Features: - A gripping rogue-lite where every round could be your last! - Meta-progression, multiple endings and unlockable power-ups! - Push your score to new heights in Endless Mode! - A hellish escape room atmosphere! - 150 + items and synergies to boost your luck! - A sinister tale of addiction and escape! Note on Save Data: This game currently stores progress locally on your device. Please be aware that uninstalling the app (or clearing app data) will delete your save file. Cloud Save & Cross-Device Sync are in development for a future update. P.S. IS THIS GAMBLING? No! CloverPit is a rogue-lite horror game, and not a slot machine simulator. Our slot machine is designed to be broken and ultimately overcome, and will never ask you for real money!

Application Description

Titan Quest has captivated legions of players since its 2006 debut. You get the all-encompassing experience of an unbridled, truly heroic journey through the worlds of Titan Quest! Your honorable quest is to save the world! The gods alone cannot defeat the Titans, so real heroes are needed - and that can only be you! Your success or failure will decide the fate of the people and the Olympians! With your custom-created hero, scour the mystical and ancient worlds of Greece, Egypt, Babylon, and China. Conquer the hordes of legendary creatures and master various weapons and martial arts: Archery, sword fighting, or the use of powerful magic! Travel a world of antiquity and Nordic mythology! Battle the beasts of mythology as you travel to the Parthenon, the Great Pyramids, the Hanging Gardens of Babylon, the Great Wall, the Tartarus Arena, and other famous places. Encounter the greatest villains of Greek mythology, discover the uncharted lands of northern Europe, search for the mythical kingdom of Atlantis, and set out on a journey across the western Mediterranean. It’s all or nothing on your glorious path! With each challenge that awaits you, you'll have to defeat bigger and stronger enemies until you reach your goal and force the Titans to their knees! Rush into battle alongside brave pet companions! Find extraordinary items with special powers that will enhance your abilities and help you on your path. Legendary swords, powerful lightning spells, magical, bows and numerous other treasures with unimaginable powers await you - all of them are at your disposal in your battles and spread fear and terror among the hideous creatures! What are you waiting for? Like no other game in the Action RPG genre, Titan Quest: Legendary Edition combines the fascinating world of mythology with endless and exciting action that you would expect from such a compelling game! Features: + Within the world of the Immortal Throne DLC, you’ll encounter the greatest villains of Greek mythology, brave the attacks of Cerberus, and hazard the banks of the River Styx. You have to interpret the prophecies of the blind seer Tiresias, fight alongside Agamemnon and Achilles, and use the wiles of Odysseus to conquer this dark new adventure. + In the uncharted lands of northern Europe in the Ragnarök DLC, you’ll brave the realms of the Celts, the Northmen, and the Asgardian gods! + Meet an explorer in the Atlantis DLC, in search of the mythical kingdom of Atlantis. A key is supposedly hidden in the diary of Herakles, which is rumored to be located in the Phoenician City of Gadir. Set out on a journey across the western Mediterranean, including the Tartarus Arena for epic battles! + All important updates have been implemented to the technically overhauled Titan Quest to grant the best gaming experience of this classic ever! + ETERNAL EMBERS DLCs available as in-app purchase - Summoned by the legendary Emperor Yao, the Hero is called back into the East to deal with a demonic threat that has been ravaging the land after the Telkine was slain. ! A note for all players who own the base version of Titan Quest: The DLCs mentioned here are also available for purchase as additional content so that all fans can upgrade their game to fully enjoy all expansions! © www.handy-games.com GmbH

Application Description

Dive into a deep story of corruption, crime and intrigue. Take the role of gritty Police Chief Jack Boyd, and come face to face with the ugly underbelly of Freeburg, a city spiraling the drain. Will Jack reach his retirement with a nice stack of bills, or will he end up broken ... or worse? Manage your staff, respond to emergencies, and investigate crimes in a city on the brink of chaos. The mafia underworld maneuvers behind the scenes, sinking their claws ever deeper into the city, even as the mayor is ready to exploit every situation to his political advantage. Choose your approach to each situation as it unfolds. Sometimes you’ll be responding to a developing crisis at a crime scene, or negotiating with Freeburg’s crime bosses. Sometimes you’ll find yourself dodging questions in the press room, or even the occasional cross-examination in the witness box. Can you keep this pressure cooker from exploding, at least for long enough to stash away a nice retirement nest egg? - Your mission is clear: make $500,000 in 180 days before Jack Boyd reaches retirement. How? That’s up to you! - Decisions, decisions! This Is the Police is all about a dark story and how you react to it. Whatever you decide, your choices will influence the game – and the fate of Jack Boyd. - The Good, the Bad, and... the Ugly? The Chief of Freeburg's Police Department deals with all kind of people. It is up to you to find the bad guys and decide how to deal with them. - Carry out your duties. As head of Freeburg PD, Jack deals with all sorts of challenges every day: responding to emergencies, managing his officers, defending the department against City Hall and a corrupt mayor, and much more. - Solve Investigations and gather evidence against the criminal gangs of Freeburg. - Deal with the competing powers of the city. Everyone offers you favors, and each one comes at a price. Rich and fully voiced story: Jack Boyd is portrayed by Jon St. John, the voice of Duke Nukem.
